title: Lumason® Infusion vs. Bolus Administrations
official: A Phase III Crossover Study to Evaluate Bolus Versus Continuous Infusion of Lumason® in Patients With Suboptimal Unenhanced Echocardiography
summary: A phase III study designed as a randomized, within-patient comparison of continuous infusion of diluted Lumason® versus the bolus administration of undiluted Lumason® for degree of LVO and assessment of LV EBD (co-primary endpoints).

interventions.name: Sulfur Hexafluoride Lipid Type A Microspheres 25 MG Injection Powder for Suspension [LUMASON]
